files.patch:
@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@
 #
 BUN ?= bun
 
-.PHONY: all build test coverage verify format fix lint release clean notes smoke help
+.PHONY: all build test verify format fix lint release clean notes smoke help
 all: build
 
 build: ## Build the project.
@@ -17,11 +17,8 @@ format: ## Format the project source.
 lint: ## Run lint checks and boundary validation.
 	$(BUN) run lint
 
-test: ## Run unit tests.
-	$(BUN) run test:unit
-
-coverage: ## Run all tests with coverage.
-	$(BUN) run coverage
+test: ## Run unit tests with coverage.
+	$(BUN) run test
 
 verify: ## Run lint, typecheck, build, and the full test suite with coverage.
 	$(BUN) run verify
@@ -36,16 +33,15 @@ clean: ## Remove generated output files.
 	$(BUN) run clean
 
 notes: ## List available notes in the repository.
-	$(BUN) run notes:list
+	$(BUN) run notes
 
 smoke: ## Run repomix version smoke test.
-	$(BUN) run smoke:repomix-version
+	$(BUN) run smoke
 
 help: ## Show available targets.
 	@printf "Available targets:\n"
 	@printf "  build     Build the project.\n"
 	@printf "  test      Run unit tests with coverage.\n"
-	@printf "  coverage  Run tests with coverage.\n"
 	@printf "  verify    Run lint, typecheck, build, and the full test suite with coverage.\n"
 	@printf "  release   Release a new version (VERSION=x.y.z required).\n"
 	@printf "  clean     Remove generated output files.\n"

@@ -32,16 +32,16 @@
     "check-boundaries": "bun run scripts/check-boundaries.ts",
     "test:unit": "bun test tests/unit --timeout 20000",
     "test:integration": "bun test tests/cli tests/bundle --timeout 20000",
-    "test": "bun test tests --timeout 20000",
-    "coverage": "rm -rf coverage && mkdir -p coverage && bun test --coverage --coverage-dir coverage tests --timeout 20000",
+    "test": "bun test tests/unit",
+    "coverage": "rm -rf coverage && bun test tests",
     "release": "bun run scripts/release.ts",
     "gen:homebrew": "bun run scripts/generate-homebrew-formula.ts",
     "check": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json",
     "fix": "biome check --write .",
     "verify": "bun run lint && bun run check && bun run build && bun test --coverage --coverage-dir coverage tests --timeout 20000",
     "copy:init": "bun run scripts/copy-init-templates.ts",
-    "notes:list": "cx notes list && cx notes orphans",
-    "smoke:repomix-version": "bun run scripts/repomix-version-smoke.ts",
+    "notes": "cx notes list && cx notes orphans",
+    "smoke": "bun run scripts/repomix-version-smoke.ts",
     "integrity": "bun run scripts/release-integrity.ts",
     "verify-release": "bun run scripts/verify-release.ts"
   },
